title: 14 New MSFS Marketplace Add-ons: worth your money?
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases so you can skip the long store page menu guessing and know exactly what you are flying next.

The marketplace just dropped a massive wave of new content for Flight Simulator 2020. If you're looking to breathe new life into your simulator sessions, this week features a massive injection of activity updates. We divide the breakdown into four major categories:

✈️ Heavy Airliner Missions & Challenges: A deep dive into the high-intensity airline challenges. We break down the Four Air Master Collection Volume 3 bundle featuring 12 IFR missions for the Boeing 747 (Alitalia, Lufthansa, and Korean Air) with authentic liveries and briefing charts at a reduced price. We also evaluate the A380 Advanced Challenges from Perfect Flight, built for the FlyByWire A380X, visiting global hubs like London Heathrow, Amsterdam Schiphol, and New York JFK.

📅 The Global Summer Schedule Wave: A look at the massive real-world summer schedules from VA Systems. We cover the new route and livery drops for Air France, All Nippon Airways, Avianca, Ethiopian Airlines, and Southwest Airlines, alongside matching airport schedule injections for Amsterdam Schiphol, Cape Town, Dallas-Fort Worth, Buenos Aires, and Guangzhou Baiyun.

🌍 Low-and-Slow Scenic Excursions: A close look at VFR flight profiles designed to test your stick-and-rudder fundamentals. We examine "Adventure Now" by Koshi flying the Cessna Grand Caravan over the Nile River with multi-language audio narration, Perfect Flight's story-driven VFR touring package across the northeastern United States in the Cessna 172, and the Simple Bush Trip USA bundle taking you through the Blue Ridge Mountains.

🔧 Environment Utilities: A review of the new Teleport Relocation & Sim Rate Tool available for both PC and Xbox. This utility allows you to instantly teleport to custom positions, map out one-tap runway pattern positions (downwind, base, etc.), and fully control your simulator rate adjustments on the fly.

Whether you choose to command a heavy multi-leg commercial jetliner, populate massive mega-hubs with accurate summer flight data, or pull back the throttle to explore historic back-country sceneries, developers are continuing to push incredible variety back into the simulator.

Let me know in the comments: are you team heavy jetliner or team bush trip for your weekend flying plans? Smash the like button, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
